lines: Twinleaf Hamlet. Edge of the snow, edge of the old story. Step off careful — the ground here is older than the map.
npcs.speaker: Airship captain

lines: The Rift is not a place. It is a wound in a place. Walk carefully. The creatures here are not wild — they are lost.
npcs.speaker: Hamlet elder

entries.sprites: hamlet + snow edge, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

entries.kind: researcher's town, first route, no dojo (shape label, not a new place name)

lines: Three lakes, three guardians, one mystery. That is the whole region, in one sentence.
Walk the first route first. The lakes wait. The Rift does not wait, but the lakes do.
npcs.speaker: Town researcher

lines: The first route is kind, for an old region. Kind is not the same as easy. Watch the grass.
npcs.speaker: Route keeper

entries.sprites: research town, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: We are a research institute. We research. The Rift is research. Do not make it a story.
antagonist.speaker: Institute speaker

entries.kind: media city, institute's public face, no dojo (shape label, not a new place name)

lines: The institute is on every screen. That is not news. That is advertising, and advertising is not the same as truth.
npcs.speaker: Media clerk

lines: This city talks fast. Walk slow, and you will hear what it is not saying.
npcs.speaker: City elder

entries.sprites: media city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: Work. Take the first badge of this region.
pre: A mining dojo is a dojo of work. Show me work, not wishes.

lines: The mine is deep, and the deep is honest. Coal does not lie. People near coal sometimes do.
The dojo is in the mine's shadow. Shadow is not darkness. Shadow is just less light.
npcs.speaker: Mine keeper

entries.sprites: mining city, Tiny City CC0 restyled + 0x72 CC0

entries.kind: flower town, valley, first Rift crack, no dojo

lines: The valley is beautiful, and the crack in the ground is beautiful too, in a way that worries me.
Do not step in the crack. Look at it, note it, and tell the next town. That is the job here.
npcs.speaker: Flower keeper

lines: Flowers grow over cracks. That is not hiding. That is healing, slow and honest.
npcs.speaker: Valley wanderer

entries.sprites: flower valley, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: We are borrowing history. Borrowing is not stealing, if you return it. We will return it. Later.
antagonist.speaker: Institute operative, at the statue

pre: A forest dojo is a dojo of patience. Trees do not hurry, and neither do I.

lines: The forest is old. The statue is older. The institute took something from the statue, and the forest noticed.
npcs.speaker: Forest keeper

entries.sprites: forest city, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

pre: A contest dojo is a dojo of grace. Grace is not soft. Grace is exact, under lights.

lines: The contest is not a battle. It is a showing. Show your creature, and show it kindly.
npcs.speaker: Contest hall keeper

lines: The Garden branch here is the same Garden, new soil. Raise them here, and they will remember both gardens.
npcs.speaker: Mochiko, Garden branch

entries.sprites: contest hall, Kenney Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

lines: The meteorite is research. Research is not yours to touch. Touch it, and you are research too.
antagonist.speaker: Institute operative, warehouse

pre: A warehouse dojo is a dojo of strength with nowhere to hide. Stand in the open.

lines: The warehouses are full of things that are not labelled. Unlabelled things are not lost. They are hidden, and hidden is a choice.
npcs.speaker: Warehouse keeper

post: You waded. Take the fifth badge.
pre: A marsh dojo is a dojo of patience in wet boots. Wade, and do not complain about wet.

lines: The marsh is not a swamp. It is a preserve. Preserve means: look, learn, do not take more than the marsh offers.
npcs.speaker: Marsh keeper

lines: Wave-Ride works here, same as before. Water is a road, if you respect it. The marsh respects you back, if you do.
npcs.speaker: Preserve guide

entries.sprites: marsh + preserve, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

entries.kind: old town, cave painting, lore, no dojo

lines: The painting is old. It shows the world before any region. Before Mochiichao, even.
The Rift is a scar in that world. A scar is not a wound, if it has healed. This one has not healed.
npcs.speaker: Cave painting keeper

lines: Regions 1–3 were chapters. This town is the footnote that reframes the whole book. Read it slow.
npcs.speaker: Celestic elder

entries.sprites: old town + cave painting, 0x72 CC0 + Tiny Town CC0 restyled

pre: A port dojo is a dojo of steel and salt. Rust is honest. Be honest, and be steel.

lines: The library has every book except the one you need. That book is on the island, and the island does not lend books.
npcs.speaker: Library keeper

lines: The island is across the water. The creature there is not wild. It is a nightmare, and nightmares do not follow Mochiioteca rules.
npcs.speaker: Port keeper

entries.sprites: port + library, Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: You waited. Take the seventh badge.
pre: Snow does not hurry. Snow waits, and then it is everywhere. Be snow.

lines: The temple is cold because the truth is cold. Warm up inside, then go back out and face it.
The ice dojo is not about ice. It is about standing still when everything says run.
npcs.speaker: Temple keeper

entries.sprites: snow city + temple, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: You stood. Take the eighth badge.
pre: A solar dojo is a dojo of light with no shadows to hide in. Stand in the light.

lines: The city runs on sun. Sun is free, and free is not the same as easy. Keep the panels clean.
npcs.speaker: Solar keeper

lines: The road to the lighthouse is the last road in the region. Walk it, and the League is next.
npcs.speaker: Lighthouse road keeper

entries.sprites: solar city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: Eight badges, mountain, snow, and cracks. That is the gate. Walk it. The cracks are not shortcuts. They are warnings.
npcs.speaker: Victory gate keeper

lines: I walked this route when the Rift was just a crack. Now it is a story. Show me you read it.
After battle: You read it. Good. The Plateau is next, and it reads back.
npcs.speaker: Veteran Ranger (talk-to-battle, ROSTER GAP)

post: Past. The Hall remembers you four times now. The Battle Zone is waiting.
pre: You walked the oldest region and did not get lost in it. Now walk past me.
champion.speaker: CHAMPION — Delta

pre: I guard the door. The Rift taught me that doors are not always where you left them.
elite.speaker: ELITE 1 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the stairs. The lakes taught me that still water is deep water.
elite.speaker: ELITE 2 (NAME GAP)

post: It remembers you. The champion's door is next.
pre: I guard the hall. The hall remembers every region, and the Rift between them.
elite.speaker: ELITE 3 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the champion's door. Knock twice, and mean it, in snow and in Rift-light.
elite.speaker: ELITE 4 (NAME GAP)

entries.music: elite loop, champion loop, hall loop calm, CC0 chiptune

lines: Fourth ascent. The Hall has a fourth page for you, if you earn it.
npcs.speaker: Plateau attendant

entries.sprites: Plateau + Hall, Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

entries.music: volcano loop, tense, CC0 chiptune; Rift loop, dissonant slow, CC0 chiptune

lines: The Battle Zone is an island with a volcano in it, and a legendary creature in the volcano. That is not a warning. That is an invitation, if you are ready.
npcs.speaker: Battle Zone keeper

lines: Down there, the world shows its bones. Do not touch the bones. Just close the wound.
The dungeon does not obey normal map rules. Gravity and exits shift as you walk it. Walk it anyway, and walk it steady.
npcs.speaker: Rift keeper, before the Rift dungeon

lines: The Rift is sealed. The signal is clean. Region 5 is on the other side of the signal.
A train line, a ship line, and a signal all point the same way. The Liberation Front is already there. That is the link, and it is not a coincidence.
npcs.speaker: Rift keeper, after sealing
